input.summary: Bedroom 4 is still fully dark (80 of 80 floor cells at light 0): no lamp is placed. Three lantern spots (32,11,54), (33,11,60), (27,11,54) are written at the end of parts/room-19.mjs build(g), but runParts refuses all three because the shell owns that room's air.
left: Blocked: runParts (minecraft-design/tools/src/build.mjs) locks every cell an earlier part placed, air included. The shell's box() fills bedroom 4's interior with air, so room-19's writes (the lanterns I added, and the furniture the designer intended) are refused. The room part places 0 blocks and build.nbt has the room unlit and empty. Fixing this means changing the lock or the shell (letting room parts write their own interior air), which is outside this lamplighter's scope, so I did not touch it.

Once the lock lets room-19 write its own air, the three lantern lines at the end of build(g) should light the room: the room check predicted 55 cells lifted to 8+ from the first lamp, 21 from the second, 2 from the third. Re-run the room check after that to confirm, and check the focal piece's light.

The designer's furnishing is also missing: parts/room-19.mjs is an empty build(g) with a comment pointing at room-19.refused-writes.txt, which does not exist in this crew dir. The bed, dresser, nightstands, writing table, rug and lanterns cannot be recovered from this directory.

Lantern spots are the room check's suggestions, not chosen for the room's look. Standing lanterns on the floor row y10 by the walls are a placeholder until the bedroom has furniture; a hanging lantern from the ceiling beam would suit a bedroom better once there is a ceiling to hang from (the plate is y17, so y16 is free).
Nothing else was changed: no other part, roof or shell file was edited, and build.nbt was rebuilt by make.sh with the room still empty.

waste.what: Worked out the three lantern coordinates by hand from the room check's suggestions, then rebuilt and re-checked to learn that every write into the room is refused by the shell's air lock.
waste.cost: 1 edit, 2 make.sh runs, 2 room checks; about 4 tool calls before the refusal was confirmed
waste.tool: `mcd room` (or the runParts report) should say up front when a room's air is owned by an earlier part, e.g. `WRITES: refused, room air owned by shell`, so lamp suggestions are not offered for cells that cannot be written

waste.what: Read the runParts lock code in build.mjs to confirm why the writes were refused.
waste.tool: `mcd check` or the build report should list each room's locked cell count and the part that owns it

companions.task: Furnish bedroom 4 (bed, dresser, nightstands, writing table, rug) once room-19 can write into its own air, so the lamps have something to light and sit beside.
Decide whether room parts may write their own interior air (the shell's box() air should not be an owned lock for the room part), and restore the missing room-19.refused-writes.txt.
